name: Executive review pack
description: Create a decision brief, evidence-led insight notes, and reader guidance.

steps.title: Executive brief
steps.markdown:
# Executive brief

## Decision required
What must the reader decide, by when, and who owns the next action?

## Headline
Record the metric, the comparison period and the unit.

steps.title: Key insights
steps.markdown:
# Key insights

## Observed result
State the change and the population.

## Driver to check
Compare volume, mix and rate before assigning cause.

## So what
Name the decision, owner and trigger.

steps.title: Methodology
steps.markdown:
# Methodology

List the source, reporting period, grain, exclusions and denominators.

steps.title: FAQ
steps.markdown:
# FAQ

## Which filters apply?
List the filters that change the headline, charts and tables.

## Who owns the report?
Add the owner and refresh schedule.
